msg: I didn't see a particular system but I found the gnomes with the bigger hats often gave a bigger mushroom value, but wasnt always the case and it was at times the smaller one. I often found the purple and brown ones also gave a better mushroom value, but again wasnt always the case. It was a nice game and really made you focus as you don't have long to decide. You have to not forget to press space when seeing the basket as it will say too slow and you will get no points for that round.
